item.title: One-Owner, 5k-Mile 2015 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 6-Speed
item.description: This 2015 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon was purchased new by the current owner and it now has 5k miles. Power is provided by a 3.6-liter V6 linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case, Tru-Lok locking front and rear differentials, and Dana 44 axles. item.title: 11k-Mile Katech-Modified 2006 Chevrolet Corvette Z06
item.description: This 2006 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 is a black-over-black example that was modified by Katech Performance in December 2023 with their Stage 1 package for the 7.0-liter LS7 V8. The build included a revised camshaft, titanium intake valves, Brian Tooley Racing valve springs, CHE valve guides, ARP cylinder head bolts, a Halltech air induction system, and a Katech ECU tune. item.description: This 2001 BMW 330Ci coupe was initially delivered to Westchester BMW of White Plains, New York, and remained registered with the original owner until 2024. Power is provided by a 345ci V8 mated to a three-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case.
